title: ipomoea dalzellii var. inaequalis
intro: Ipomoea dalzellii var. inaequalis, commonly known as the Convolvulaceae family plant, is a perennial climber native to the Western Ghats of India. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea dalzellii var. inaequalis include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and lowering fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
